meta.title: feat: Server-side pagination, filtering and search for eval results table
meta.body_summary: Implement server-side pagination, filtering, and search for eval results to handle large evaluations, with a new /eval/table/:id endpoint, database indices, and frontend hooks.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI Codex delivered large full-stack server-side pagination feature; reviews focused on code quality, SQL injection risk, and design consolidation; merged after non-blocking bot and human comments.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 5174 changed lines across 38 files, this is a large change by absolute volume. It fits a significant feature addition (server-side pagination) that merged after extensive reviews and bot suggestions without blocking requests.

review_details.concern_detail: Ellipsis bot flagged raw SQL query building in getTablePage as potential SQL injection risk, suggesting parameterized queries; Sourcery bot flagged various code style issues.
review_details.performance_claim: Server-side pagination, filtering, and search improve performance for large eval results tables.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Complex multi-file feature with significant testing; agent's code had style issues and SQL injection vectors flagged by bots but corrected non-blocking; human review clarified design decisions.

detection_detail.code_reading: Bots performed static review (Ellipsis spotted SQL injection, Sourcery suggested code quality improvements); human reviewer will-holley asked about hook consolidation and URLSearchParams usage.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after performance metrics or load test; only narrative claim about handling large evals.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Several commits addressed test failures, circular dependencies, and misnamed indices. No revert occurred.

core_change_summary.description: Implemented server-side pagination, filtering, and search for eval results by adding new endpoint /eval/table/:id, database indices for search/filter, and frontend hooks (useEvalData) and store updates.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Most line changes are in migration snapshots; core logic changes in eval model and frontend.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: added server-side pagination with drizzle migration and basic endpoint.
Added server-side searching with new indices.
Fixed misnamed index and final cleanups; removed unused hook.

review_signals.summary: Warned about building raw SQL queries using string interpolation and suggested parameterized queries.
Noted sequential await in loop inside getTablePage, recommended using Promise.all for concurrency.
Multiple suggestions: rename filteredBody, check isFetching before 'No results', use object destructuring, inline variables.
Asked if fetchEvalData can be consolidated with fetchEvalById from useEvalData.
Pointed to react-router useSearchParams for URL search param handling; author clarified they are building a new URL, not reading existing.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with initial pagination commit, then multiple force-pushes and iterations over several days.
After marking ready for review, ellipsis and sourcery bots provided feedback within ~2 hours.
Human reviewer will-holley chimed in two days later with design questions, which led to brief discussion.
PR merged after 7 days with no blocking requests.
